title: SmartAutomator - Adaptive API/UI Automation Framework
description: Intelligent automation framework that auto-selects between API calls and UI automation. Three script generation modes: prompt-based, screenshot-based, and recording-enhanced. No POM — AI dynamically generates resilient label-based XPath selectors. Includes humanizer layer and self-healing on selector failure.
features: Humanizer (Bezier mouse, Gaussian delays, realistic typing)

sample_input.example: smart-automator run --workflow linkedin_post.yaml --content 'Excited about my new project'

sample_output.example: Strategy: UI (no API available) | Generated 5 action steps | Executed in 12.3s | Status: SUCCESS
